responsibility: Core declaration and type-construction module for the Ada GCC interface. It translates GNAT entities into GCC identifiers, decls, and types; manages elaboration of incomplete and limited-with types; builds substituted variants of array/record/union types for discriminants and templates; computes Ada-specific size notions such as RM size; and maintains caches that annotate values and associate dummy types with subprogram entities, making it the main owner of Ada declaration/type lowering before statement translation in trans.c.
